correctness.rationale: Finite unique stationary chain. The exact q_k recursion is a one-round balance identity, checked via exact rational stationary solutions for 2–4 coupons. Uniform convergence of the continuous integrand gives stationary full-state mass exp(-nI+o(n)). Monotone coupling proves P_empty(S_t=all)<=stationary mass. Common-draw/common-loss coupling bounds total variation by n[(1-1/n)(1-c/n)]^t; O(\(n^2\)) blocks each hit with probability >=stationary mass/2. Union and geometric-tail bounds sandwich log T and log E T at rate I(c). Strict convexity of the exponential yields I(c)>log(1+c). No step relies on finite experiments for an infinite assertion.
